de: A Mughal army under Humayun and Bairam Khan defeats an Afghan army under Sikandar Shah Suri in the battle of Sirhind, allowing Humayun to capture Delhi and reestablish the Mughal Empire in India.

te: Fatahillah expels Portuguese forces from Sunda Kelapa, now regarded as the foundation of Jakarta.
dz: 法塔赫将葡萄牙军队从现在被视为雅加达基础的Sunda Kelapa驱逐出.
de: Fatahillah expels Portuguese forces from Sunda Kelapa, now regarded as the foundation of Jakarta.

de: The Hungarians defeat the East Frankish army near the Rednitz River, killing its leader Gebhard, Duke of Lotharingia (Lorraine).

t: 当月早些时候教皇利奥三世去世后,选举了教皇斯蒂芬四世.
te: Election of pope Stephen IV following the death of pope Leo III earlier that month.
dz: 当月早些时候教皇利奥三世去世后,选举了教皇斯蒂芬四世.
de: Election of pope Stephen IV following the death of pope Leo III earlier that month.

dz: 韦尔西尼基亚战役:克鲁姆所率领的布尔加尔人击败了伊迪尔内附近的拜占庭军队. 皇帝迈克尔一世被迫放弃支持亚美尼亚人利奥五世.
de: Battle of Versinikia: The Bulgars led by Krum defeat the Byzantine army near Edirne. Emperor Michael I is forced to abdicate in favor of Leo V the Armenian.

t: 以弗所会是第三个普世会会,开始处理涅斯托利安主义.
te: The Council of Ephesus, the third ecumenical council, begins, dealing with Nestorianism.
dz: 以弗所会是第三个普世会会,开始处理涅斯托利安主义.
de: The Council of Ephesus, the third ecumenical council, begins, dealing with Nestorianism.

dz: 平德纳战役:卢修斯·艾米利乌斯·保卢斯手下的罗马人击败了战后投降的马其顿国王珀尔修斯,结束了第三次马其顿战争.
de: Battle of Pydna: Romans under Lucius Aemilius Paullus defeat Macedonian King Perseus who surrenders after the battle, ending the Third Macedonian War.

te: Ptolemy IV Philopator of Egypt defeats Antiochus III the Great of the Seleucid kingdom.
dz: 拉菲亚之战:埃及的托勒密四世腓力活佛击败了塞琉西德王国大帝安提俄克三世.
de: Battle of Raphia: Ptolemy IV Philopator of Egypt defeats Antiochus III the Great of the Seleucid kingdom.
